candidates.name: Contour Construction (Contour Construction Inc. on its site)
candidates.reason: Its restroom accessories page FAQ says 'We install toilet partitions, grab bars, hand railings, mirrors, dispensers' to manufacturer specifications and from project drawings. It's a commercial carpentry and specialties installer in Omaha that also does some multi-family work.
candidates.partition_evidence: FAQ on /restroom-accessories/: 'Yes. We install toilet partitions...'. Says 'Our focus is professional installation. We can work with owner-furnished materials.'
red_flags: The site name is Contour Construction Inc., not the 'LLC' in the candidate list

license.name: Ruck Specialties
license.registry: Nebraska Department of Labor Contractor Registration search (dol.nebraska.gov/conreg)
license.note: No registration found on 2026-11-19. Searches by DBA and corporation name ('Ruck Specialties', 'RUCK SPEC') returned 'No contractors were found matching this search criteria.' The broader search 'Ruck' returned only unrelated trucking firms. A search on the company phone, (833) 444-1733, also found nothing. The company site (http://www.ruckspecialties.com/) names 'Ruck Specialties LLC', based in Omaha. It describes itself as a Division 10 supplier representing 50+ manufacturers (toilet partitions, accessories, lockers), mentions an install team, and gives info@ruckspecialties.com. It may be registered under another legal or owner name. The registry's paging did not work for automated requests, so the 68108 ZIP results could not be fully scanned. Confirm with NDOL Contractor Registration, (402) 471-2239, before listing. City of Omaha Permits and Inspections was not checked.
